p0.original: 第二章 生物心理学、神经科学与人类天性
p0.en: Chapter 2: Biopsychology, Neuroscience, and Human Nature

p1.en: Chinese translator of this chapter: Sun Yuhao

p3.original: 本章视频导读，请扫描二维码观看。
p3.en: Scan the QR code to watch the video introduction to this chapter.

p4.original: 人类天性指“天生的性质”。“天生”是指遗传。遗传学的英文是genetics，因此承载遗传内容的生物分子被称作gene，就是基因。基因是人“天性”的载体，那么，是不是人性、心理与行为都决定于基因（遗传）呢？如果是，那么我们自己的一切优点与成功都要归功于父母、祖先，而一切缺点与失败也要归咎于他们，但事实并非如此。例如，即使是同卵双生子（遗传信息完全相同），如果在不同的环境中长大，其个性也会有一定的差别。如果脑遭遇某种损伤或接受过某些塑造，即使基因不变，人的心理与行为肯定会发生巨大变化。现在心理学已经积累起足够多的科学知识可以告诉我们，基因、神经与环境在复杂互动中塑造了每一个人。打一个简化的比方，基因与脑的关系类似于一辆车与司机的关系（如果精确一点，基因则更像是车的设计图）。车是预先设计好、在工厂的大机器上制造出来的，有发动机、有刹车，还有方向盘。但是，车在现实中上路后，何时加速、何时减速，走什么路线、开向哪里，是否遵守交通规则？这些都不取决于车，而是取决于司机。好司机懂交通规则、懂路线，还懂修车。司机和车走合适的道路，遵守交通规则，才能很好地行驶，到达想去的地方。回到这一章的主题，我们可以这样理解，基因密码确定了“天生”的内容，人的内部心理与外部行为需要基因与环境的交互，而神经系统起到调控的作用。那么，基因、脑与我们所处的环境具体是怎样交互作用而造就了多姿多彩的我们的呢？这一章里有具体、清晰、易懂的回答。享受它吧！
p4.en: Human nature means “natural nature”. "Breeded" means genetic. The English language of genetics is générics, so the biological molecules that carry the genetic content are called générals. Genetics are the carrier of human “naturality”, so is it human nature, mentality and behavior that determine genetics (genetics)? If so, all our merits and successes are due to our parents and ancestors, and all shortcomings and failures are attributable to them, but that is not the case. For example, even the twin children of the same egg (whose genetic information is identical) have a certain difference in personality if they grow up in different environments. If the brain suffers from some kind of damage or has been shaped, even if the genes are constant, there will certainly be a dramatic change in the mind and behaviour of the human being. Now psychology has accumulated enough scientific knowledge to tell us that genes, nerves and the environment shape everyone in complex interactions. A simple example is that genes have a similar relationship to the brain (and, if it is more precise, genes are more like car designs). Cars are pre-designed and built on large machines in factories, with engines, brakes and steering wheel. But when, when, and where, when, when, when and where to go when the car will accelerate and slow down when it will actually get on the road, and are rules of the road observed? It depends not on the car, but on the driver. A good driver knows the rules of the road, knows the route and fixes the car. Drivers and vehicles follow the right road and follow the rules of the road to travel well to where they want to go. Turning to the subject of this chapter, we can understand that the gene code defines what is “born” and that the internal psychology and external behaviour of human beings require the interaction of genes and the environment, while the nervous system acts as a regulator. So, how exactly did the genes, the brain and the environment in which we live interact to create the colourful us? This chapter contains specific, clear and understandable answers. Enjoy it!

p7.en: The brain is essentially the foundation of human thinking, emotions, behaviour and understanding.
